meta.title: GenAI at work — routed papers
meta.tagline: Every flag the pipeline raised on a routed paper, resolved by a coder.
meta.description: The routed pass of the GenAI-at-work validation as a review template over the pipeline's record: a paper routed because its record contradicts an inclusion criterion, a headline estimate scores high on the checks or a coder flagged it; the reasons and the score as the head, one row per flag with its source and the extracted value, a verdict and a corrected value per flag, a full-review flag for the paper.

stages.label: Resolve
stages.help: This paper was routed for the reasons above. Each row is one flag: a check an estimate failed (its source and the extracted value given), a cell the runs disagree on, a criterion the record contradicts, or a coder's flag. Open the source in the PDF and give a verdict; for a corrected value, write it as printed. A criterion row takes keep_paper or exclude_paper. Press done when every row has a verdict.

questions.name: verdict
questions.label: Verdict
questions.help: model_right = the extracted value stands; corrected = give the right value; cannot_tell = the paper does not settle it; keep_paper / exclude_paper = for a criterion row, the decision on the paper; not_applicable = the flag does not apply

options.label: Exclude the paper
options.help: the flag shows the paper does not meet an inclusion criterion

options.label: Not applicable
options.help: the flag does not apply to this paper

questions.name: full_review
questions.label: Full review needed
questions.help: yes when what you saw makes the whole extraction of this paper doubtful; say why
